# Matter.js 0.20.0

Official MIT-licensed release build from https://github.com/liabru/matter-js/blob/0.20.0/build/matter.min.js.
The upstream minified build is unchanged; its local filename is build/matter.cjs and package.json main points to it.
Vendored because the session cannot access the npm registry. Other upstream package metadata and LICENSE are preserved.
